# kaleido_platform_permission_set (Resource)

A permission set: permissions (actions and a resource selector) that grants give to user groups and applications. Its types, fields and actions come from each service's RBAC schema and are checked by Access Manager. Needs access grants on (the access_grants toggle).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read, resolve and sign with the keys labelled team=treasury in one keystore of a Key Manager,
# and read that keystore. The keystore is a param: each grant of the set names its own.
resource "kaleido_platform_permission_set" "key_signers" {
  name        = "treasury-key-signers"
  description = "Read, resolve and sign with the treasury keys in a keystore"
  permissions_json = jsonencode([
    {
      actions = ["read", "resolve", "sign"]
      resourceSelector = [
        { field = "resource.type", op = "eq", values = ["keymanager.key"] },
        { field = "resource.within.keystore.name", op = "eq", param = "keystore" },
        { field = "resource.labels.team", op = "eq", values = ["treasury"] },
      ]
    },
    {
      actions = ["read"]
      resourceSelector = [
        { field = "resource.type", op = "eq", values = ["keymanager.keystore"] },
        { field = "resource.name", op = "eq", param = "keystore" },
      ]
    },
  ])
  params_json = jsonencode([{ name = "keystore", description = "The keystore" }])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the permission set, unique in the account
- `permissions_json` (String) The permissions (use jsonencode): a list of {actions, resourceSelector}, each condition of a selector {field, op, values} or {field, op, param}

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the permission set
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels on the permission set
- `params_json` (String) The params the set declares (use jsonencode): a list of {name, description}, each filled by the grants of the set

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
